metadata.title: Qadr — borrow and lend things in your neighbourhood
metadata.description: Borrow tools, books, camping gear and kitchen appliances from people nearby, and lend what you rarely use. Free, in Uzbekistan.

hero.title: Good things are worth sharing.
hero.lead: Borrow a drill, a tent or a stand mixer from someone in your mahalla, and lend what sits idle on your shelf.
hero.imageAlt: Looking out of a tent at a mountain lake and pine forest
hero.caption: Sardor's tent has been to Chimgan, Zaamin and Arslanbob this year.

categories.title: What people borrow
categories.lead: Most things get used a few times a year. Here is what neighbours are lending right now.

nearby.title: Near you this week
nearby.lead: Recently listed within a few kilometres of the city centre.

find.title: Find it nearby
find.body: Search for what you need and see who lends it in your area.

ask.title: Ask the owner
ask.body: Pick your dates, accept their terms and send a request. Questions go in the chat.

return.title: Pick up and return
return.body: Once approved, you both see each other's phone number. Return on time, then rate each other.

trust.title: Trust grows with every return
trust.quote: I bought a drill to hang one shelf. Since then it has hung about forty, and none of them are mine.
trust.author: Dilnoza
trust.portraitAlt: A cordless drill on a wooden table beside floor plans and screws

points.verified: Every profile is verified by email
points.ratings: Both sides rate each other after every return
points.phone: Phone numbers appear only after a request is approved

cta.title: The drill in your cupboard could help three neighbours this month.
cta.body: Listing takes two minutes. You decide who borrows, when, and on what terms.

register.title: Join your neighbours
register.lead: Borrow what you need, lend what you rarely use. Free.
register.name: Your name
register.agree: By creating an account you agree to the community rules.
register.done: Account created. One more step: connect Telegram.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email. We'll send a code to the Qadr bot in Telegram.
forgot.done: If this account has Telegram connected, the code is waiting in the Qadr bot.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: Enter the code from the Qadr bot in Telegram and choose a new password.
reset.done: Password changed. You can log in now.

connect.title: Connect Telegram
connect.lead: One last step. Qadr verifies every neighbour through Telegram, so you know who you lend to.

steps.open: Open our bot and press Start
steps.back: Come back here: your account opens by itself

connect.why: Your number is shown only to people you have an approved loan with. Password reset codes arrive in the bot.

connect.unavailable: Telegram connection is temporarily unavailable. Try again a little later.

telegram.blocked: Our bot can't reach you. Open Telegram and press Start again.
telegram.unavailable: Telegram linking will be available soon.
